entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
This is completely unacceptable! I bought your so-called premium cycling shoes and they're a piece of junk. I want my money back, and I want it now!

I'm very sorry to hear you're having a bad experience. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault with the cleats, or something else?

Don't give me your script! The shoes gave me horrible blisters after just two rides! They're unusable. I don't care about the cleats, I care that my feet are raw! I want a refund. Get me your manager if you can't do it. I'm about to light you up on every review site on the internet.

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order details to check on the return eligibility for you. Can I get your name or order number?
The name is Alex Chen. You better find it, this has been a complete waste of my time.
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order right here for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered about 51 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, really? So you're going to process the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for a full refund immediately. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. Well... good. Thank you for handling that so quickly.
You're very welcome, Alex. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
